name: Wren AI
description: Wren AI brings conversational business intelligence (GenBI) to Claude. Connect your data warehouse, and anyone on your team can ask questions in plain language and get accurate answers, powered by a semantic layer that keeps queries governed and consistent.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wren AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wren AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloud.getwren.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wren AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wren AI provides these MCP tools: ask, generate_chart, generate_sql, generate_summary, get_project_metadata, list_projects, respond_clarification, and run_sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wren AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wren AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Wren AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wren AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wren AI is developed by Wren AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
